name: Zen Maximize
_comment_version: L'intero 'version' rappresenta il contatore cumulativo dei rilasci/commit locali
author: albeph
description: Automatically moves maximized applications to their own dedicated workspaces to provide a distraction-free, full-screen experience. Un-maximizing seamlessly restores the application to its original workspace. Integrates perfectly with GNOME's native dynamic workspaces.
